title: Mapping Feature Absorption Prevalence Across the SAE Width Sweep

original_idea.body: Replicate the first-letter spelling task across Gemma Scope SAEs of multiple widths, auto-detect absorption, and plot absorption rate vs width and L0; light inference.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Absorption prevalence tells auditors how much to distrust SAE monosemanticity, relevant but indirect catastrophic-risk chain (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Public Gemma Scope SAEs + spelling-task detection; standard tools, light inference (level 5).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open SAEs, externally runnable reliability audit (level 4).

novelty.reasoning: Absorption established; width-sweep prevalence mapping partly open; partially addressed.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Width-sweep prevalence map may be partly open.
